baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual locative is followed by the coordinated indefinites فاكهة, نخل, and رمان.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sequence moves from a broad class of pleasant produce to a fruit-bearing tree and then a named fruit. It therefore joins consumable yield, productive organism, and particular specimen rather than merely repeating three synonyms.

activation_trace.role: Fruit as pleasant produce supplies the broad edible-yield category.
The date-palm tree shifts attention from consumable object to the organism that keeps producing.
The familiar pomegranate supplies a sharply named fruit within the wider abundance.

changed_reading.before: A flat inventory of three fruits located in two gardens.
changed_reading.after: A layered abundance combining generic yield, a productive tree, and a particular fruit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فاكهة names enjoyment as well as produce, while نخل carries sifting and choosing branches inside the same three-item list.
baseline_models.mechanism: Pleasure is not presented as undifferentiated excess: the latent sieve and choice images make the named produce look curated, with the pomegranate functioning as a concrete selected example.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment turns the produce into an experienced quality, not only an object.
Sifting flour through a sieve contributes a filtering operation to the list.
Choosing the best makes the named items representative selections rather than an exhaustive catalogue.
The concrete pomegranate is the list's visibly selected delicacy.

changed_reading.before: The gardens contain an uncurated mass of desirable food.
changed_reading.after: Their abundance is presented through choice specimens calibrated for delight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The produce nouns denote achieved fruit, while a branch of ف ك ه images rich milk thickening before birth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The branch juxtaposes mature yield with an imminent-birth state. Read temporally, the list can mark fruition as an arrival from hidden ripening rather than a set of permanently static objects.

activation_trace.role: Rich early milk before birthing supplies a threshold image in which nourishment is ready before emergence.
The palm supplies the living bearer through which ripening becomes recurrent.
The pomegranate supplies the mature, bounded outcome of the process.

changed_reading.before: Fully formed produce simply stands available.
changed_reading.after: The verse can also catch abundance at the threshold of coming to fruition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus recomposes two earlier inventories: earthly fruit and palm in sheaths, then every kind of fruit in pairs. Repeating fruit and palm but adding pomegranate converts the line into a selective reprise that moves from enclosure and totality to recognizably named specificity.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce is the repeated generic term around which the reprise is built.
The focus palm repeats the earlier productive tree and stabilizes the comparison.
The newly named pomegranate makes the reprise more specific rather than verbatim.
Earlier earthly fruit supplies the first lexical recurrence of pleasant produce.
The earlier palm supplies the second exact botanical recurrence.
The plant sheath or fruit envelope makes the earlier inventory one of covered potential.
Allness as encompassing completeness supplies the total field from which the focus samples.
The same pleasant-produce branch ties the first garden pair to the focus list.
Pairing as kinds or classes makes the earlier abundance taxonomic as well as numerical.

structural_cues: 55:52 and 55:68 repeat the dual locative فيهما, but the focus replaces totalizing كل and زوجان with named items.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetitions, plant enclosure, completeness, kinds, and the added pomegranate; I infer deliberate recapitulation and specification. A live alternative is ordinary catalogue variation without cross-section comparison.

changed_reading.before: The line is a self-contained list of garden produce.
changed_reading.after: It is a compressed reprise linking earthly recognizability, paired totality, and a newly specified paradisal example.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flowing and forcefully springing water precedes the focus produce, while later fresh greenery confirms the ecological chain. The two gardens read as irrigated systems whose hydraulic abundance issues in fruit, palms, and pomegranates.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce is the edible output of the proposed water-to-yield mechanism.
The date palm supplies the rooted organism that converts water into recurring yield.
The pomegranate supplies a second concrete fruiting output.
Free flow and coursing supplies sustained water movement through the earlier garden pair.
A running water source supplies the immediate reservoir inside the focus gardens.
Water that gushes and multiplies supplies pressure and abundance immediately before the produce.
Fresh green vegetation supplies the visible ecological consequence of ample water.

structural_cues: 55:66 names two gushing springs, 55:67 intervenes as a refrain, and 55:68 names their garden yield.
The dual locative فيهما carries the same garden pair from water source to produce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flowing springs, gushing water, fresh vegetation, and adjacent fruit; I supply the irrigation-causes-fruiting arrow. The live alternative is descriptive co-presence without an asserted causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The produce is decorative abundance placed in the gardens.
changed_reading.after: It is the downstream yield of a visibly operating irrigation ecology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier paired waters meet through a relation while a between-space prevents transgression; later fruits occur in pairs and a second garden pair remains other than the first. This activates فيهما as coupled abundance with preserved difference, not simple duplication.

activation_trace.role: The generic produce supplies a kind shareable across both members of the pair.
The palm supplies a common productive form without requiring identical garden arrangements.
The named pomegranate sharpens the question of how shared kinds are distributed across the dual container.
Two vast waters supply the surah's earlier model of paired domains.
Two opposing things coming together supplies coupling without immediate collapse.
The interstice between two things supplies maintained separation inside relation.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the complementary image of linkage.
Transgressing a limit supplies the blocked motion that preserves each member's integrity.
A mate joined to its mate supplies paired organization within the fruit domain.
Otherness supplies explicit differentiation between the two garden pairs.

structural_cues: Duals recur as two horizons, two waters, two gardens, two springs, and paired fruits.
The focus's فيهما grammatically couples two referents while leaving their internal distribution unstated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coupled waters, a boundary, paired kinds, and an other garden pair; I project coupling-with-difference onto the focus dual. The alternative is that the dual merely states identical contents in each garden.

changed_reading.before: Both gardens duplicate one identical stock of produce.
changed_reading.after: The two gardens may be coordinated ecologies that share kinds while retaining distinct internal distributions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Womb, birth, plant sheath, gestation, interior, and nearness-to-birth branches converge on the focus branch of rich nourishment before delivery. The fruit list becomes an emergence sequence: abundance ripens inside protected containers and arrives as mature yield.

activation_trace.role: Rich early milk before birth supplies latent nourishment poised to emerge.
The living palm carries maturation from enclosure into repeated visible yield.
The enclosed, mature pomegranate supplies the bounded endpoint of ripening.
The female womb supplies the primary protected-growth container.
Laying down a burden in birth supplies the transition from containment to appearance.
A plant sheath or fruit envelope translates biological containment into botanical form.
Conception and the beginning of pregnancy supplies an initiating maturation image.
The inside of a thing supplies an interior zone where maturation can remain hidden.
Nearness of birth supplies the temporal threshold just before accessible yield.

structural_cues: The locative فيهما holds all three yields inside a dual enclosure.
Plant sheaths at 55:11 and the near harvest at 55:54 surround the garden catalogues with hidden-growth imagery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branch images of enclosure, gestation, birth, and pre-birth nourishment; I infer that protected containment enables ripening. A live alternative is that these are independent root resonances with no shared developmental arrow.

changed_reading.before: The fruits are finished objects with no temporal depth.
changed_reading.after: They can be read as the visible delivery of a long, protected maturation process.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sufficiency, measurement, equitable shares, and the prohibition on short measure activate the focus sifting and choosing branches. Even total abundance is ordered: the list presents provision selected and distributed without deficiency rather than luxury defined by excess.

activation_trace.role: Delighted ease supplies the experiential goal of provision.
Sifting supplies discrimination within abundance.
Choosing the best supplies selection by quality rather than mere quantity.
Sufficiency and making enough supplies a non-excessive criterion for abundance.
Estimating a thing by weight supplies calibration.
A share or apportioned portion supplies distributive structure.
Shortchanging measure supplies the excluded failure mode: abundance must not hide deficiency.
Encompassing completeness shows that calibration can coexist with total availability.

structural_cues: The surah establishes measure and non-diminution before any garden inventory.
The garden catalogues combine duals, pairs, totality, and selected names.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficiency, weighing, shares, non-shortchanging, completeness, and focus-level sifting; I infer an ordered provisioning system. The alternative is that measure governs ethics and cosmos but does not organize this produce list.

changed_reading.before: Paradisal plenty is valuable because it is sheer excess.
changed_reading.after: Its value can lie in complete, sufficient, and finely apportioned provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching, gathering, clarification, and recognition make the focus syntax perform an act of classification. A broad category is gathered and then made intelligible through two named members; the edible catalogue is also a small exercise in البيان.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant social talk gives the fruit category a latent verbal and convivial register.
Choosing the best supplies the act of selecting instructive examples.
The familiar pomegranate supplies a concrete name by which the broad class becomes recognizable.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the pedagogical movement from availability to apprehension.
Gathering and collecting supplies the list-form operation.
Revealing meaning through speech or sign makes coordinated naming an explanatory act.
Recognition through a distinguishing trace supplies the outcome of naming particulars.

structural_cues: The focus begins with a broad noun and follows it with two more determinate botanical kinds.
Simple coordination makes distinctions visible without defining them abstractly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching, collection, verbal clarification, recognition, and selected examples; I infer that the catalogue enacts pedagogy. The alternative is purely referential enumeration with no metalinguistic force.

changed_reading.before: The nouns only report what is present.
changed_reading.after: Their ordering also articulates abundance into recognizable and discussable kinds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pleasant produce is framed by beneficent action, reciprocal return, nurturing completion, blessing, and the possibility of denial. The immediate refrain turns the catalogue from scenery into a gift-address whose reception can be truthful or false.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and enjoyment supplies the experienced benefit being given.
The concrete pomegranate makes the gift sensibly particular rather than abstract.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies a reciprocal relation between good and response.
Doing good supplies beneficence on both sides of the reciprocal formula.
Blessings identifies the produce as a bestowed benefit.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion supplies the giver's cultivating role.
Attributing a thing or speaker to falsehood supplies the failed reception of the gift-sign.

structural_cues: Identical refrains at 55:67 and 55:69 place the produce inside a direct second-person challenge.
55:60 establishes reciprocity shortly before the second garden pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enjoyment, beneficence, recompense, nurture, blessing, and denial; I infer a gift-response circuit centered on the produce. The alternative is that the refrain comments generally on the whole garden section rather than this list in particular.

changed_reading.before: The fruits are amenities available to an unaddressed observer.
changed_reading.after: They are particular acts of nurture that address recipients and solicit truthful acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perishing forms, an abiding source, harvest from the plant, and stable growing good turn the focus into a regenerative interface. Individual fruits may be taken and vanish while the productive order keeps renewing their availability.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the consumable and therefore replaceable yield.
The palm tree supplies a persisting bearer capable of repeated production.
The bounded pomegranate supplies a discrete fruit that can be consumed and renewed.
Cessation and disappearance after continuance supplies finitude at the level of produced forms.
Continuance and remaining supplies the contrasting persistence of the source.
Taking fruit from its growing place supplies harvest as the transfer from source to eater.
Stable, growing good supplies renewal rather than inert permanence.

structural_cues: The perishing-and-remaining contrast precedes the garden section, while growing blessing closes the surah.
Indefinite produce nouns can denote recurrent yields rather than numerically fixed objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, persistence, harvest, a productive tree, and stable growth; I infer a renewal cycle linking them. The alternative is a theological permanence contrast with no claim about the garden's material process.

changed_reading.before: Eternal abundance means the same fruits remain as static possessions.
changed_reading.after: Abundance may be eternal as regeneration: finite yields are continually harvested from an abiding productive order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-botanical rain-sifting branch of نخل and turns a noun for palm into a material process. It remains anchored by that exact focus root, the literal palm branch, adjacent scattered spray, and later swaying greenery. Render only as a possible canopy or microclimate resonance, never as a replacement lexical meaning for نخل.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus palm stands between generic produce and pomegranate, where it can mediate water and fruit rather than function only as another item.

activation_trace.role: The date palm supplies the physical canopy and fruit-bearing organism.
A sifted fall of light rain supplies the strange filtering image applied to the canopy.
Pleasant produce supplies the yield sustained beneath the proposed filter.
Scattered spray supplies droplets available to be spatially filtered.
Spread, swaying greenery supplies the moving vegetative surface that catches and redistributes spray.

changed_reading.before: The palm is one static member of the produce list.
changed_reading.after: It may also be imagined as living infrastructure whose canopy sifts spray into a fruiting microclimate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is odd because it lets hostile social branches of ف ك ه cast a negative shadow over literal fruit. It remains valid as an ethical contrast because the same focus root also names wholesome delight, while focus-level sifting and context-level crime, recompense, and good action provide a sorting mechanism. Downstream prose must present it as a contrastive shadow, not claim that the fruit denotes vice.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فاكهة carries both pleasant enjoyment and branches of insolent exultance and feeding on reputations; نخل contributes a sieve within the same focus line.

activation_trace.role: Wholesome delighted enjoyment supplies what the garden preserves.
Insolent exultance supplies a corrupt mode of pleasure to be excluded.
Making sport of people's reputations supplies socially predatory enjoyment to be excluded.
Sifting supplies the ethical separation between delight and its corrupt modes.
Crime and culpability supplies the context's category for rejected conduct.
Recompense for action supplies consequences to the sorting process.
Doing good supplies the positive counterpart to socially harmful enjoyment.

changed_reading.before: Garden pleasure is morally neutral gratification.
changed_reading.after: The focus can carry an ethical purification of pleasure: delight remains, while arrogant and predatory enjoyment has been sifted out.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because ordinary syntax strongly favors palm and pomegranate as botanical nouns, not place names. It remains anchored by explicit toponymic branches for both focus roots and by context images of fertile ground, enclosed orchard, and branching terrain. Render as a scale-shifting spatial resonance only, never as a claim that the ayah names historical locations.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both نخل and رمان have place-name branches, allowing the coordinated botanical nouns to flicker into landscape markers inside فيهما.

activation_trace.role: Transferred names of places and people lets the palm term operate as a possible spatial marker.
A place named Rumman, including mountain or paired hills, supplies a compact topographic image.
Soft fertile ground supplies the substrate of the enlarged landscape.
An orchard hidden by trees supplies territory enclosed by vegetation rather than a pantry of objects.
A branching bough or extended offshoot supplies spatial articulation within that territory.

changed_reading.before: The nouns scale only to edible items and trees.
changed_reading.after: They may briefly scale up into a named, branching garden geography: produce as landmarks within inhabited terrain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it moves from edible fruit to speech and companionship. It remains anchored in the focus branch of pleasant joking talk and is activated by context branches of intimacy, clarification, and conversational return. Qualify it as an experiential overtone of the garden scene, not a lexical substitution for فاكهة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun فاكهة directly shares its root inventory with pleasant joking and congenial conversation.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant joking and sociable talk supplies the focus-level verbal anchor.
Delighted ease supplies the affective atmosphere in which conversation flourishes.
Intimacy that removes estrangement supplies companionship.
Clarifying meaning through speech or sign supplies intelligible exchange.
Conversational return supplies reciprocal dialogue within the later garden scene.

changed_reading.before: The produce satisfies appetite in silence.
changed_reading.after: Its delight may include the social event around it: recognizable food, ease, and reciprocal congenial speech.

strongest_changes: The immediately preceding springs turn the list into the yield stage of a working irrigation ecology.
Repeated fruit catalogues make 55:68 a selective reprise that moves from earthly sheaths and total paired kinds to named specificity.
The surah's dual systems activate the two gardens as coupled but potentially differentiated ecologies.
Perishing, harvest, remaining, and growing blessing permit eternal abundance to mean regeneration rather than static inventory.
The refrains and reciprocity convert produce into a relational gift that demands recognition.
summary.what_was_special: Three ordinary produce nouns became a junction where repetition, water, duality, measure, maturation, pedagogy, reciprocity, and renewal remain simultaneously live. The root inventories also preserved less conservative resonances: canopy filtration, ethically sifted pleasure, toponymic scale, and convivial speech.
remaining_uncertainties: The grammar does not decide whether every named item belongs identically to each garden or to the pair collectively.
Hydraulic causality is a reader-supplied arrow from adjacency and material fit, not an explicit causal connective.
Sifting, gestational, social, and toponymic branches are activations of the focus roots, not claims that those are the direct lexical senses in 55:68.
The repeated catalogues may encode deliberate comparison, but ordinary stylistic variation remains live.
